about_the_game:
You stumble upon a creature unlike any other the last Henki, a shapeshifter without a form to call its own. Together, you set out across a handcrafted blocky world to recover the shattered fragments of its lost heritage. What you find along the way will change both of you. 

Taival is a co-op action RPG for up to 4 players built around one central idea: your companion evolves with you. As you explore, fight, and discover creatures across the seamlessly connected realms of Taival, your Henki absorbs their forms becoming a fighter, a mount, and an ally that grows more powerful with every new encounter.

DISCOVER YOUR HENKI'S TRUE POTENTIAL

Your Henki companion is the heart of Taival. As you encounter new creatures across the world, Henki can absorb their essence and shift into their form each one bringing a unique set of abilities to battle and exploration. A hulking beast that absorbs damage. A swift mount that scales cliffsides. A cunning predator that strikes from the shadows. 

The more of the world you explore, the more forms you unlock. Master new skills and find the combination that fits your playstyle or your party's. 

A WORLD BUILT TO WANDER

Taival is a handcrafted open world built from the ground up with a charming, voxel-style blocky art style. Multiple seamlessly connected realms each bring their own environments, inhabitants, and secrets from rolling highlands to dense forests and ancient ruins waiting to be uncovered. 

Hidden around every corner are random encounters with randomized loot, bosses, and challenges that ensure no two runs feel the same. Whether you're following the main story or chasing a rumor from a villager you met at a crossroads, there's always a reason to keep moving. 

ADVENTURE TOGETHER YOUR WAY

Taival is built for playing together. Invite up to 3 friends and journey as a full party each with their own character, companion, and skill tree. What makes Taival's co-op special: you can mix local split-screen and online players in the same session, simultaneously. One friend on the couch, two more joining from across the world all in the same adventure. 

When your group faces a pivotal quest decision, everyone gets a say. Group dialogue lets every player vote on the outcome so no one is just along for the ride. 

GROW YOUR CHARACTER. GROW YOUR COMPANION

Taival's progression runs on two tracks that grow in tandem. For your character: unlock abilities, improve your combat skills, and even level up your fishing. For Henki: master new creature forms, unlock mount abilities for faster exploration, and build a companion that feels uniquely yours. The deeper you go, the more the world opens up. 

KEY FEATURES

  • Shapeshifting companion (Henki) — absorb creature forms found throughout the world, each with unique combat and traversal abilities

  • Handcrafted open world — multiple seamlessly connected realms with distinct environments, inhabitants, and stories

  • Up to 4-player co-op — mix local split-screen and online players in the same session, simultaneously

  • Group quest dialogue — every player votes on major story decisions together

  • Unlockable mount forms — fast-travel the world in style using Henki's discovered creature forms

  • Charming voxel-style art — a handcrafted blocky world with a warm, inviting visual identity

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Graphics: GTX 1660 Super (or equivalent)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Graphics: RTX 2070 Super (or equivalent)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space

short_description: Play together on the couch or online - or both at once. Taival is a cozy co-op adventure where you and up to 3 friends explore a handcrafted world alongside your shapeshifting companion. Discover new forms, progress through narrative quests, and make the journey your own.
